name: Cabo Verde
status: in force: every lote of Cabo Verde has its code, issued on 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20 (provisional until people confirm it); registry published in registry/; open: Apache-2.0 code, ODbL 1.0 data, CC BY 4.0 documents (LICENSING.md)
summary: Home codes people can remember: the short plate name of their bairro, zona or povoação (at most 12 characters and 2 words; the full official name is printed small for context) plus a 3- or 4-digit number ("Palmarejo 12 34", "São Filipe 21 29" for Lote Achada São Filipe), unique in the whole country on its own: every zone with the same plate name draws from one national number range for that name, cut into frozen blocks ("Fazenda 24 33" is Praia, "Fazenda 34 48" is Tarrafal), so no municipality or island is ever needed after it; one code per lote (plot or compound), pointing to its gate or front door. A machine form with a check digit (PR-0973-1234-0) exists for systems and the QR code on plates; people never see the check digit. Spot addresses are Plus Codes, the grid Correios de Cabo Verde adopted in 2016; the Correios postcode is shown beside the code, never replaced.

existingSystems.verdict: postal codes exist but are coarse (locality/delivery-zone level) and not door-level

pointTo.format: NNNN before the locality, e.g. 7600 PRAIA
pointTo.how: shown beside every N-Ways code when the postcode is verified; never derived from the code

pointTo.how: the N-Ways spot layer IS the Plus Code; no competing grid

pointTo.how: a lote may carry the NIP as a reference; an N-Ways code is never a title

pointTo.how: mapping table when INE publishes zones; census totals used as priors and checks

levels.why: how people place themselves, the UPU address line, the first Correios postcode digit; but Santiago (9 municipalities) is too large and too many-governed to be one key; printed on cards and plates for information only: the remembered code alone is unique nationally

levels.inCode: only in the machine form (checked against the block owner)
levels.why: smallest elected authority (Câmara Municipal), which names streets and numbers doors (DL 5/2012) and curates its zone names; key in the machine form; NOT needed to tell same-named zones apart

levels.count: 1,778 zones (from about 3,800 named places); official names under 1,547 keys, plate names under 1,360
levels.why: the place word people already use for their address (bairro in towns, povoação or zona in the country); the code uses its short plate name (at most 12 characters and 2 words), the official name is printed small; plate names repeat (254 names in 672 zones), so all zones of one plate name share one national number range and each owns frozen blocks in it: the code is unique nationally on its own

hierarchy.subdivision: below the municipality the code uses zones (bairros, zonas, povoações): 1,778, the largest Achada Santo António, plate name ASA (2,855 lotes, 4 digits, block 1000-9599)

designCriteria: 1. Memorability: an address works only if people remember it and get it without effort, so memorability comes before brevity and elegance
2. Beside official systems (Correios postcode, municipal door numbers, INGT cadastre, Plus Codes of Morada Certa)
3. Building and door level, pointing to the gate
4. Works offline; open; stable; privacy (codes describe places, never people)

memorability.chosen: place word + number: '<plate name> <3 or 4 digits>', plate name at most 12 characters and 2 words, unique nationally on its own (one number range per plate name)

options.remember: a name people already say + a door-number-sized number
options.spoken: same in Portuguese and Kriolu; numbers said as a door number (3 digits) or two pairs (4 digits)
options.verdict: chosen; long map names (632 of 1,778 over 12 characters) get a short plate name; repeated plate names (254 names in 672 zones) are separated by national name ranges, not by context
rejected: Praia needs 5 digits (31,052 lotes x 3 headroom = 93,156 > 9,000); the bairro is what people already give as their address

options.remember: letters people never use for places
options.spoken: Portuguese letter names rhyme (be ce de ge pe te ve; efe ele eme ene erre esse)
options.verdict: rejected: hard to remember and to say over the phone

options.form: digits only nationwide (e.g. 7-digit like a phone number)
options.verdict: rejected: a wrong digit gives a valid place on another island; no meaning to the owner

options.remember: letters, a plus sign, changes per 14 m
options.verdict: kept as the spot layer (Correios precedent), not the home code

arithmetic.headroom: x3 at first issue (Cabo Verde buildings grew 31 % from 2010 to 2021: 114,297 -> 150,016; peri-urban Praia grows faster; x3 leaves about 2 free numbers between neighbours)

ranges.5 digits: 10000-99999: units of 1000 (the first pair), 90 units; only if a name ever needs it (no name needs it); never more than 5

register.largest: ASA, Achada Santo António (Praia): 2,855 lotes x 3 = 8,565 -> 86 units, block 1000-9599, 4 digits

v03OfficialNames.note: before plate names (names taken raw from the map)

arithmetic.growth: a full block takes the next free unit of its name; a new zone with an existing name takes a new block from the name's spare units; a full name range opens the next length; no issued number changes and blocks are never renumbered
arithmetic.rule: the length belongs to the NAME: each zone of the name gets ceil(3 x lotes / unit) units; the name takes the shortest length whose units hold all its zones plus 2 free units for future zones of that name; a zone alone with its name has 3 digits up to 233 lotes, 4 up to 2,933

grouping.3: 214 said as a door number: 'duzentos e catorze' / 'duzentu i katorzi'
grouping.4: 12 34 said as two pairs, like phone numbers: 'doze, trinta e quatro' / 'dozi, trinta i kuatu'
grouping.5: 12 345: a pair and a door number (no name needs it)

memorability.notRemembered: the check digit (only in the machine form; plates and forms show the name and number), the machine form, the name index, the official name (printed small for context; typed, it decodes too); the municipality and island are printed as information and are never needed to decode
memorability.evaluation: after issue (starting in Praia): recall after one week and after one month; error rates for spoken (phone call), typed (app search, WhatsApp) and written entry; comparison with the Plus Code of the same home

zones.what: the place word: a frozen namespace with an official name, a plate name and aliases, built once from the N-Ways locality layer (OpenStreetMap suburbs, neighbourhoods, villages, towns; GeoNames localities that are not landforms)
zones.rules: tools/build_zones.py: candidates (no streets, squares or school points) -> one per name within 2 km -> town bairros win over GeoNames points -> each lote to the nearest candidate in its municipality -> zones under 15 lotes merged unless isolated (> 1.5 km) -> the map name is the official name -> index in Hilbert order; then tools/build_names.py: plate names, national name keys of the plate names, ranges and blocks, and for the same plate name twice in a municipality the nearest other zone as 'near' for the card

duplicates.rule: 'Name NNNN' is unique in the whole country on its own; context (phone position, saved places, a municipality or island after a comma) is never needed and never used to choose, because people give their code without context and a qualifier would be left out when it matters
duplicates.method: all zones whose PLATE names have the same national name key share one number range; each zone owns blocks of whole units (100 numbers for 3 and 4 digits, 1000 for 5) holding 3 x its lotes, given from the bottom of the range in order of municipality index then zone index; at least 2 units stay free; 'Name NNNN' decodes to the one block holding NNNN; a number in no block is not a code
duplicates.frozen: blocks are fixed at first issue and never renumbered; growth only adds blocks from the name's spare units; a renamed zone keeps its plate name and blocks (the new name becomes its official name); a new plate name that already exists is shown on the card only, so ranges never collide

qualifiers.rule: a name whose zones would not fit 5 digits is split by an established qualifier people already say (as 'Achada Santo António' is said, not 'Achada'), for its new zones; listed in cv_engine.QUALIFIERS; none is needed

example.name: Fazenda
example.note: seven zones; four share the name only after shortening

duplicates.withinMunicipality: 208 zones share a plate name with another zone of the same municipality; e.g. the three Achadinhas of Santa Catarina are Achadinha 11 00 / 12 50 / 13 50 (blocks 1000-1199, 1200-1299, 1300-1399); the 'near' zone is shown on the card only
duplicates.files: engine/data/names.json (frozen at first issue), registry/names.csv; model/building-stats.json -> names

zones.aliases: national name key (cv_engine.name_key, Portuguese and Kriolu) of the plate name: case and accents fold; apostrophes, hyphens, dots and slashes are spaces; articles and the prepositions de/da/do/das/dos/d' drop (Chã de Baixo = Chã Baixo, As Hortas = Hortas, Ponta d'Água = Ponta Água); Sto/Sta/S. expand; ALUPEC spellings fold (tx/tch = ch, dj = j, k = c/qu); numerals are spelt out (a code never holds two numbers); aliases (every official name, Platô = Plateau, AGT = Achada Grande Trás, Brava/Djabraba) may never equal another plate name's key nor be claimed by two (dropped and listed). These rules join 10 pairs of names that differ only by an article or a preposition
zones.boundaries: a zone is a list of lotes, not a boundary: a disputed or renamed bairro never changes a code; a new official name becomes the official name and the old one an alias
zones.newSettlements: 15 or more new lotes more than 1.5 km from any zone form a new zone, named with the residents and the Câmara Municipal
zones.file: engine/data/zones.json, engine/data/names.json (frozen at first issue); registry/zones.csv, registry/names.csv

plateNames.rule: the name in the code is a plate name of at most 12 characters (NFC, every character counts one) and at most 2 words (linking words de/da/do/das/dos/d'/e/di/du do not count; a hyphen separates words); no digits; short enough for a plate, a form field and one breath
plateNames.fields: zone: officialName (printed small on the card and plate, never required, decodes when typed), name (plate name), plateRule (as-is, cleaned, abbreviated, known, distinctive, council), needsCouncilChoice, plateCandidates (<= 3), plateReason, plateSource
plateNames.derivation: engine/reference/plate_names.py, configured in tools/build_names.py: documented short form (with source) -> clean generic words (Lote, Bairro, Zona, Condomínio, Casa Para Todos, Povoação, Complexo...), brackets, text after a slash, second spellings -> fits as is -> abbreviate Santo/Santa/São/Nossa Senhora before a name (Sto, Sta, S., N. Sra) -> the most distinctive run of whole words, preferring the specific end ('Lote Achada São Filipe' -> 'São Filipe') -> flagged for the Câmara when unclear, when it would equal a municipality, seat, island, regional capital or country elsewhere, or when nothing fits; a word is never cut

known.source: Inforpress via Balai, Tabanka de ASA (https://www.balai.cv/balai-kultural/praia-tabanka-de-asa-com-festividades-de-rua-em-homenagem-ao-santo-padroeiro/); A Nação, 4 Feb 2026 (https://www.anacao.cv/noticia/2026/02/04/praia-prisao-preventiva-para-o-principal-suspeito-do-homicidio-de-jovem-de-17-anos-na-asa-em-2024/)
Expresso das Ilhas, 9 Aug 2025, 'CMP repudia roubo de plantas...' ('na subida de Achada Grande Frente (AGF)'), https://expressodasilhas.cv/topico/achada-grande-frente

plateNames.aliasOnly: AGT (Achada Grande Trás): in the map's alias list, but no published source found; alias only, the zone goes to the council
plateNames.council: needsCouncilChoice: the Câmara Municipal chooses the plate name; the first candidate is used provisionally and its codes are issued provisional; the choice changes the name once and keeps every number; the engine refuses an unflagged plate name over the limit
plateNames.numerals: spelt out ('África 70' -> 'África Setenta', 14 characters: flagged, provisional 'África'; 'África 70' typed still decodes)
plateNames.aliases: every official name is an alias of its plate name; an alias claimed by two plate names or equal to another plate name is dropped and listed (names.json -> droppedAliases; none in the register)

home.pattern: <plate name> <number>, unique nationally on its own; plate name at most 12 characters and 2 words
home.number: 3 digits (100-999) or 4 digits (1000-9999, written and said as two pairs); the length belongs to the name; 5 digits (12 345) only if a name ever needs it
examples: São Filipe 21 29 (official name Lote Achada São Filipe, Praia)
João Vaz 214 (official name Chã de João Vaz, Paul)
home.display: São Filipe 24 30 · Lote Achada São Filipe · Praia, Santiago · 7600 (the official name, municipality, island and postcode inform; they are never needed to decode; official areas show the municipal address instead)
home.meaning: one lote: a plot or compound with its structures; usually one building in Cabo Verde towns; resolves to its gate or front door

machine.use: APIs, partner systems, QR on plates; 1:1 with the home form; the zone is decoded from name + number and the key must equal its municipality

plate.small: Praia · Santiago; the official name in small type when it differs from the plate name; municipality and island for information only

codes.entrance: entrances are listed in the lote record (entrance 1 = the gate or front door); not part of the code people use

spot.length: 10 (~14 m) for sharing, 11 (~3 m) for doors and gates
spot.shortForm: drop 4 or 6 leading digits against the nearest named locality: '9V+X5 Praia'
spot.clip: issued on land inside a municipality outline only; at sea the app shows coordinates, except ports and marinas listed in the registry

check.binding: inside a name every number has exactly one owning zone, frozen at issue, so name + number fix the area; the zone digits are kept out of the string so that a one-digit slip into another same-named zone is always caught; the machine form's municipality key must equal the owning zone's
check.where: plates, forms, the machine form and QR; never required from memory
detects: every adjacent transposition (exhaustive for 3- and 4-digit numbers)
92,701 of 92,701 slips that land in another zone of the same name (self-test)
22,952 of 22,952 corrupted machine forms (one wrong digit, a swap, or the wrong municipality key)
check.spokenEntry: a mistyped or misheard number is caught by sparseness instead: at x3 headroom about 2 in 3 numbers are unused, and the app always shows what the code points to, with its municipality ('casa de 2 pisos, Fazenda, Tarrafal, perto de ...') before navigating
check.alternative: ISO/IEC 7064 MOD 11,10 over municipality, zone and number: misses about 2 % of adjacent swaps (12/21, 56/65, 09/90 ...), and binding the zone digits catches only 90.6 % of cross-zone slips

cellSizes.note: Cabo Verde has no computed cell code of its own: spot = Plus Code. The settlement type sets which Plus Code length the app offers; the home code (zone + number) is per lote.

bySettlement.type: dense town grid (Plato, Mindelo centre, Achada Santo Antonio)
bySettlement.why: terraced houses 5-8 m wide: a 14 m cell covers two or three doors

bySettlement.type: town expansion and bairros on slopes (Praia periphery, Monte Sossego)
bySettlement.why: unfinished and informal houses close together

bySettlement.type: rural achadas, ribeiras and hillside villages (Santo Antao, Fogo, interior Santiago)
bySettlement.why: houses 20-100 m apart; a 14 m cell names one house

bySettlement.type: resorts and condominiums (Santa Maria, Sal Rei)

lotes.definition: the addressable unit: a plot or compound with its structures and its entrances (usually one gate or one front door)
lotes.cvPattern: town houses are mostly terraced and wall to wall: one footprint = one lote; rural houses come with a separate kitchen, latrine, water tank or curral; resorts and condominiums are estates with one main gate

rules.name: enclosure
rules.signal: N-Ways enclosures (derived from OpenStreetMap): schools, hospitals, barracks, government sites, hotels
rules.group: footprints whose point-on-surface lies in the same enclosure form one lote

rules.name: estate
rules.signal: an enclosure of 2 ha or more with 20 or more footprints (resort, condominium)
rules.group: an estate record with its gates; each house inside is its own lote

rules.name: rural annexe
rules.signal: footprint under 30 m2 within 4 m of a footprint of 40 m2 or more, fewer than 40 footprints within 100 m
rules.group: joins the larger footprint's lote as a structure

rules.name: no merge of terraced houses
rules.signal: touching or near footprints in town
rules.group: never merged automatically: each is a household

rules.name: people
rules.signal: 'these buildings are one home', 'this is the gate', 'this building is two houses'

rules.name: split merged footprints
rules.signal: door confirmations of two households in one footprint (common where imagery merges terraced rows)
rules.group: one footprint becomes two lotes; the original code stays with the larger part

size.heightM: OSM height, else building:levels x 3.0 m; the machine-learned height field of the footprint dataset is a rendering filler in Cabo Verde and is never used
size.floors: OSM building:levels, else round(height / 3.0), else unknown (counted as 1 for floor area, flagged as a lower bound)

structure.code: Palmarejo 12 34.2 (home code + structure index; machine PR-0973-1234-0.2)
structure.buildingId: osm:way/194097852 or nw:<hash> for Google/Microsoft footprints
structure.name: only for businesses and public buildings

lote.nip: cadastre parcel number, only if the owner shows a CIP

public: lote code, structures, footprints, class and status of every structure
name of businesses and public buildings (as the owner publishes it)
street and door number issued by the municipality

steps: 1 gate: stand at the gate or front door; GPS averaged 10-20 s; one photo of the gate -> primary entrance and spot code (Plus Code, 11 digits) shown at once, offline

2 outline, one of: (a) tap corners on imagery; (b) walk the inside of the wall with the camera (ARKit/ARCore tracking, GPS averaged over the walk, snapped to imagery and nearby footprints); (c) import a survey plan: beacon coordinates in EPSG:4826 (WGS 84 / Cape Verde National) or WGS 84, typed or photographed, or an INGT cadastral parcel by NIP where the island is a cadastral area
3 describe: households (number), structures, floors, use, finished or still building (inacabado)

4 provisional code: the zone of the nearest home, and the middle free number between the gate's Hilbert neighbours in that zone's block (SPEC.md 7.4), e.g. a new home beside ASA 60 62 gets ASA 61 05; it is never in another same-named zone's block, and it can go on the gate the same day
5 confirmed: deliveries or visits arrive at the gate, no neighbour dispute within 30 days, or new imagery or footprints show the structure
safeguards: the flow says, in Portuguese and Kriolu: 'Um código N-Ways é uma morada, não é título de propriedade' (an address, not a land title)
overlap with an existing lote, a cadastral parcel or a public space: flagged, not issued; resolved by people or the municipality
checks: gate on the outline, closed loop, plausible size (12 m2 to 2 ha), GPS and AR track agree within 5 m, not in the sea or a ribeira bed
privacy: keep the outline and the gate photo only; no video, no interior
offline: the spot code is immediate; the lote code is issued on the next connection by the Cabo Verde registry, the single source of codes

cvLegal.cadastre: INGT holds the cadastre (Resolução 18/2014); cadastral areas finished on Sal, Boa Vista, Maio and São Vicente (DL 37/2014 regime, amended to DL 16/2019); new regime DL 12/2024 (not read in full)
cvLegal.datum: EPSG:4826 WGS 84 / Cape Verde National (Lambert Conformal Conic); older plans may use island datums and the 1969 military chart
cvLegal.surveyors: cadastral work by private people or firms needs authorisation and an alvará from the cadastre service under DL 29/2009; 2024 rules unverified
cvLegal.tenure: mostly private freehold and State land under the civil code and land registry; no customary tenure system
cvLegal.permits: building permits come from the Câmara Municipal (licenciamento urbanístico); the code does not prove a permit

stability: a code is never moved, never reused, never lengthened
a name's blocks are frozen at issue and never renumbered; a new zone with an existing name gets a new block from the name's spare units
demolished: retired (status demolido), kept in the registry
split lote: the original code stays with the part that keeps the primary entrance; others get new codes
merged lotes: both codes stay valid; the lower value becomes primary, the other an alias
regrouping structures between lotes never changes an issued code; structure indices are never reused
municipal boundary change: codes keep their key, zone and blocks (the key is a namespace, not a claim about today's boundary)
doorConfirmation: the door or gate is confirmed by agreement: arrivals of different people, couriers delivering, the household twice; agreement settles it, with no manual review queue

gettingIt.principle: zero effort: nobody has to look a code up

channels.steps: 0 taps: 'O teu código de casa: Palmarejo 12 34' shows on the home screen once home is saved
1 tap: open the app at the gate, 'É a minha casa?' -> yes
1 tap: share by WhatsApp or SMS as a link (nways.ng/a/PR-0973-1234-0) with the code in words
0 taps: printed with the code and a QR code; scanning opens navigation to the gate
5 steps (gate, outline, describe, provisional code, confirmed) for new buildings
a courier, bank or utility looks up the code for a customer's address only with the customer's consent or from a code the customer gave; no reverse lookup of people

coverageMask.rule: where the government already has an address, it is used as written and shown first; every building still has its home code
coverageMask.official: street name + door number given by a Câmara Municipal (DL 5/2012) or a future national register, shown exactly as written, with the home code beside it
coverageMask.notOfficial: the Correios 4-digit postcode (area-level): shown beside, the door-level model applies under it

values.official: numbered street, number known: official address shown first, home code issued
values.official-pending: presumed numbered, register not yet shared: home code issued; the door number joins it once the register is shared

coverageMask.boundary: street frontages; sources: municipal register > door plates confirmed by 2+ people > OSM addr:street+addr:housenumber (evidence)
coverageMask.growth: only towards official; on hand-over the official address is shown first and the home code stays as an alias resolving to the same door; its number is never given to anyone else
coverageMask.found: no national address register; no published municipal register (Praia site unreachable; São Vicente has a toponymy/cadastre councillor, no register; INGT cadastre portal = parcels) (October 2026)
